title: Bone Crack
blurb: A crisp skeletal crunch that makes entire rooms wince without anybody deciding to. Sound designers have known for decades that the crack sells the injury far better than any visual does — celery snapped near a microphone has broken more limbs on screen than any stunt team. That is why this works on stretches that go slightly too well, falls that land wrong, and any physical event the viewer should feel in their own body. Deploy it for sympathetic pain, chiropractic content, and full-body cringe. Nobody hears this comfortably.
origin: A crisp cartilage-and-bone crunch for maximum wince.
